fields.label: Source / link
fields.help: HF / Zenodo / paper URL. Where to open the dataset.

fields.label: Hindi hours
fields.help: Approx hours of Hindi (or best estimate). Not total multilingual size.

fields.label: Hinglish / CS hours
fields.help: Code-switched Hindi–English speech hours if known. 0 if mono Hindi.

fields.label: Conversational?
fields.help: Is it dialogue-like / spontaneous? Lecture CS ≠ chat.

fields.label: Native labels already in data
fields.help: What the dataset already ships: emotion, style, scenario, CS ratios, etc.

fields.label: Fit for our wedge
fields.help: P0 = use in annotation pilot. Skip = out of scope for v1.

fields.label: Can we get ~5–6 of our tags?
fields.help: yes-native = labels already map. yes-manual = you can mark by ear. hard = audio rarely shows those acts.

fields.label: Which candidate tags fit here?
fields.help: Tick tags you believe this data can support (native or hand-label). Aim 5–6 strong ones across P0 sets.

fields.label: How would tags get there?
fields.help: e.g. map Rasa HAPPY→excited; hand-label MUCS switches; LLM draft + human accept.

fields.label: What do I think of it?
fields.help: Short gut: useful / misleading / wrong domain. One paragraph max.

fields.label: Notes / free views
fields.help: Anything else: listen notes, shard IDs tried, risks, next action on this set.
